title: Cash-Based Profitability-Quality Diversifier
one_line: Chib et al. (2025) FF6 unspanned channel 1 'fundamental quality' 기반. Cash-based profitability(Q35+Q09) + Operating Accruals(AC07)의 composite. Beta 하위 40% 유니버스 제한으로 L-118 beta dominance 해결.
core_reference: Chib, Xiao & Zhao (2025, SSRN 6494339); Ball et al. (2016, JFE)
